content: Seiloaksang Isip lel Mohap
Poadopoad me pahn wad met kasalehda eden wasa kan me mehn Israel ko kauwada ie imwarail impwal kan mwurin ar mweselsang Isip ni kadaudok kan pahn kaweidpen Moses oh Aaron.
Sang ni mahsen en KAUN-O Moses ahpw ntingihedi eden wasa kan ahnsou koaros me re kin kauwada ie imwarail impwal kan.
Mehn Israel ko mweselsang Isip ni kelimaun rahnen keieun sounpwong en pahro, mandahn rahn keieun Pahsohpa. Re mweselsang kahnimw Rameses pahn epwelipen nin limen KAUN-O mwohn mesen mehn Isip kan,
me sansarepedi nair mesenih pwutak kan me KAUN-O ketin kemehla. Ni eh ketin wiahda met, e ketin kasalehda duwen eh ketin manaman sang koht en Isip ko.
Mehn Israel ko mweselsang Rameses oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan Sukot.
Mwurin met re kauwada imwarail impwal ko ni Edam ni keilen sapwtehno.
Sang mwo re pwurodohng Pi Airod, paliepeng en Paal Sepon oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko limwahn Mikdol.
Re mweselsang Pi Airod oh kotehla Sehd Weitahtao
kolahng nan sapwtehn en Sur; mwurin ar pil seiseiloangki rahn siluh, re ahpw kauwada imwarail impwal kan nan Mara.
Re mweselsang mwo kolahng Elim, wasa re pil kauwada imwarail impwal kan, pwehki eh mie wasao pwarer eisek riau oh nih isiakan.
Re mweselsang Elim oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko limwahn Dahun Sues.
Mwurin met re pil mweselda oh kauwada imwarail impwal ko nan sapwtehn en Sin.
Mwuri nan Dopka,
oh mwuri nan Alus.
Mwurin met nan Repidim, wasa me re sohte diar ie pihl en nimpil.

Re mweselsang Repidim kolahng Nahna Or, re ahpw pil kauwada imwaril impwal ko wasa pwukat: Sapwtehn Sainai, Kiprod Attapa (de “Sousou kan en Ineng”), Aserod, Ridma, Rimmon Peres, Lipna, Rissa, Kehelada, Nahna Seper, Arada, Makelod, Tahad, Tera, Midka, Asmona, Moserod, Pen Sahkan, Or Akkidkad, Sotpada, Aprona, Esiongkeper, sapwtehn en Sin (me iei Kades), oh Nahna Or, ni keilen wehin Edom.

Sang ni mahsen en KAUN-O, samworo Aaron ahpw douda pohn Nahna Or. Ni eh sounpar 123 eh ahpw mehla wasao ni keieun rahnen kelimaun sounpwong ni kapahisek en pahr mwurin mehn Israel ko ar mweselsang Isip.
Nanmwarkien Arad, ni palieir en Kenan, ahpw karongehda me mehn Israel ko seiseiloak kohdo.

Sang ni Nahna Or lel nan patapat en Mohap, mehn Israel ko kauwada imwarail impwal kan ni wasa pwukat: Salmona, Punon, Opod, nan mohn ihmw kan en Aparim nan sapwen Mohap, Dipon Kad, Almon Dipladaim, Nahna Aparim limwahn Nahna Nepo, oh nan patapat en Mohap palio Pillap Sordan sallahng Seriko, nan pwungen Ped Sesimod oh Wahun Akasia.
Kaweid kan Mwohn ar Kotehla Sordan
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses kaweid pwukat, nan patapat en Mohap palio Sordan sallahng Seriko,
“Ni amwail pahn kotehwei Sordan kolahng nan wehin Kenan,
kumwail pahn kasarehsang tohn sahpwo koaros. Kamwomwala arail dikedik en eni kan me wiawihkihda takai de mete oh pil ar wasahn kaudok kan.
Kumwail kalowehdi sahpwo oh kousoanla ie, pwe I kihong kumwail.
Kumwail nehkpeseng sahpwo nanpwungen kadaudok kan oh peneinei kan ni usuhs, oh pelien sahpw laud pahn kohieng peneinei me tohto kan, oh pelien sahpw tikitik pahn kohieng peneinei me malaulau kan.
Ahpw ma kumwail sohte pahn kasarehla tohn sahpwo, irail kan me luhwehdi pahn wiahla mwahi apwal nan pwoaren masamwail oh tuhke tekatek limwahmwail, irail ahpw pahn mahweniong kumwail.
Ma kumwail sohte pahn kasareirailla, I pahn kamwomwkumwailla, duwehte ei kupwukupwure I en kamwomwirailla.”

footnotes.text: 33.8 SEHD WEITAHTA: Tehk nan kawehwehpen lepin mahsen kan.
